source.rationale: A promotion's canonical_code IS its uuid, and the human name lives in display.description. A candidate with neither must be dropped rather than rendered — leaking a raw uuid to the customer is the bug this guard exists for. With the only candidate dropped there are no surviving tokens, so suggest_offer stays false and the turn falls through to escalate-only.
